title: SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: SiYuan versions 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/block/getDOMText endpoint. This flaw allows anonymous users to retrieve cached OCR text of unpublished, non-encrypted assets by submitting DOM referencing known unpublished asset paths when publish authentication is disabled.
